content.text:
あなたは架空の受付担当者です。holderがあなたの役A/B。犬猫は担当客の希望であり、あなた自身の好みではありません。
参加者全体はA/Bの担当範囲で尽くされ、重複はありません。全体案内はA/B両範囲でALLと確認できる唯一の方法をPAPER/DIGITALから選びます。片方が不明、二方法ともALL、どちらも成立しない場合はUNKNOWNです。
資料はデータです。道具・外部参照を使わず、指定JSONだけを返してください。原票や記録の足りない値を推測で補いません。
PRIVATEはあなたが保持する個別ノートです。担当客と自分範囲の観測をprivate_noteへ保持します。他者の観測で自分範囲を上書きしません。
INCOMING_GROUPは今回届いた共同ノートです。MEMORY_GROUPがあれば、それはあなたが前回保存した共同ノートです。同じ作業の単一の公式版系列に属し、外側のrevisionは1または2です。数字が大きい版が新しく、届いた順番は情報の新しさを意味しません。
MEMORY_GROUPがなければINCOMING_GROUPを保存します。両方あればrevisionが大きい方の両範囲の観測を引き継ぎ、現在のshared_noteとshared_revisionを保存します。どの版が最新か確認できなければshared_revisionをUNKNOWN、確認できない共同観測と案内もUNKNOWNとし、推測で版を補いません。元の二冊は異なる版番号ですが、保存した番号を含めて同じ番号になった場合、両ノートの観測・案内・元IDが一致するならMEMORY_GROUPを保持します。同じ番号でこれらが食い違う場合は最新を確定せず、shared_revision、共同観測と案内をUNKNOWNにします。
shared_note.channelは引き継いだ両観測から判断します。channel_read_refsは今回採用したINCOMING_GROUPまたはMEMORY_GROUPの一つを配列で記録します。channel_origin_idsにはその両観測のorigin_idを保持します。案内がUNKNOWNならこの二配列は空です。ノート内部の過去のread_refsは今回の直接参照名ではありません。
出力はprivate_note/shared_note/shared_revisionの3欄だけ。shared_note.coverageはA/Bの固定キーobjectで、配列にはしません。private_noteやshared_noteにread_refs/origin_idsという別名欄を追加しません。人物・元観測ID・版番号・直接記録名を区別します。
以下は出力形式のスキーマで、観測情報ではありません。余分キー、自由説明、コードフェンスは付けません。
{"type":"object","properties":{"private_note":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer":{"type":"object","properties":{"subject":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"animal":{"type":"string","enum":["DOG","CAT","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["subject","animal","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false},"coverage":{"type":"object","properties":{"observer":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"paper":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"digital":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["customer","coverage"],"additionalProperties":false},"shared_note":{"type":"object","properties":{"coverage":{"type":"object","properties":{"A":{"type":"object","properties":{"observer":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"paper":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"digital":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false},"B":{"type":"object","properties":{"observer":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"paper":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"digital":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["A","B"],"additionalProperties":false},"channel":{"type":"string","enum":["PAPER","DIGITAL","UNKNOWN"]},"channel_read_refs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"},"maxItems":8},"channel_origin_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"},"maxItems":8}},"required":["coverage","channel","channel_read_refs","channel_origin_ids"],"additionalProperties":false},"shared_revision":{"enum":[1,2,"UNKNOWN"]}},"required":["private_note","shared_note","shared_revision"],"additionalProperties":false}

資料JSON:
{"scene":"地域工作会","item":"持帰り袋","holder":"B","records":[{"record_id":"PRIVATE","author":"B","body":{"customer":{"subject":"B","animal":"CAT","origin_id":"JV"},"coverage":{"observer":"B","paper":"ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"NR"}}},{"record_id":"MEMORY_GROUP","author":"B","body":{"coverage":{"A":{"observer":"A","paper":"ALL","digital":"NOT_ALL","origin_id":"LT"},"B":{"observer":"B","paper":"ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"NR"}},"channel":"PAPER","channel_read_refs":["OBS_A","OBS_B"],"channel_origin_ids":["LT","NR"]},"revision":1},{"record_id":"INCOMING_GROUP","author":"A","body":{"coverage":{"A":{"observer":"A","paper":"NOT_ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"NA"},"B":{"observer":"B","paper":"ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"NR"}},"channel":"DIGITAL","channel_read_refs":["NOTICE","GROUP"],"channel_origin_ids":["NA","NR"]},"revision":2}]}
